visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit studio environment decorated with traditional Chinese elements. A woman with long brown hair, wearing a traditional-style lilac and white blouse, is the central figure. She stands before a background featuring ornate wooden door frames, red lanterns, and scrolls with vertical calligraphy. To her bottom left, a cartoon snake character with festive attire and a hat appears. She speaks directly to the camera, using energetic hand gestures to emphasize her greeting and the significance of the date shown on the on-screen graphics. (2) The woman continues her discourse, maintaining a steady eyeline with the camera. She uses various hand gestures, such as pointing and open-palm movements, as she explains different customs and taboos for the third day of the Lunar New Year. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional studio setup. Behind her, the traditional decor remains static, providing a consistent cultural context. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom of the screen, tracking her spoken words perfectly. (3) A visual transition marks the final segment of the video. The scene shifts from the live-action host to a red graphic background. First, a golden, stylized calligraphic text '迎春' (Welcome Spring) rotates into the center of the frame. This is followed by a stationary red graphic featuring the cartoon snake character holding a lantern, more festive red lanterns, and the speaker's website URL at the bottom. This concluding screen serves as both a seasonal greeting and a final brand CTA for the viewer.
